description:
Microsoft 365 Outlook API - Send emails, read messages, search inbox, manage folders, organize with categories, set rules, and automate email workflows. Includes SMART tools for bulk operations and common patterns.

⚠️ CRITICAL: ALL Microsoft 365 tools MUST be called through the execute_tool meta-tool for proper OAuth credential injection. DO NOT call these tools directly. Always use: execute_tool(tool_name='toolname', ...parameters)

tools.name: microsoft_outlook_send_email
tools.description:
⚠️ TEMPORARILY DISABLED: This tool now saves emails to DRAFTS instead of sending them.

⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='microsoft_outlook_send_email', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

CURRENT BEHAVIOR: Creates a draft email in Outlook Drafts folder instead of sending. User must manually review and send from Outlook.

Original purpose: Send an email via Microsoft 365 Outlook. Supports HTML content, attachments, CC, BCC, importance flags, and read receipts.

Example response:
Draft Saved: **Email Draft**
- Draft ID: `abc123`
- Note: Email saved to Drafts folder for manual sending
- Action Required: Open Outlook and send manually

body.description: Email body content (plain text or HTML)

tools.description:
⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='microsoft_outlook_smart_bulk_send_personalized', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

Example response:
Created: **New Document**
- ID: `abc123`
- URL: https://example.com/doc/abc123
- Link: [New Document](https://example.com/doc/abc123)

🎯 SMART: Send personalized emails to multiple recipients with mail merge. Automatically handles rate limiting, personalization with {{fields}}, and tracks delivery status. Much more efficient than calling outlook_send_email in a loop.

recipients.description: List of recipients with personalization data

delay_seconds.description: Delay between sends to avoid rate limits (default: 1)

tools.name: microsoft_outlook_list_messages
tools.description:
⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='microsoft_outlook_list_messages', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

🎯 PERFORMANCE TIP: ALWAYS use filtering parameters (max_results, unread_only, search, filter) to reduce data size and improve response time!

List emails from inbox or specific folder. Returns message metadata including sender, subject, preview, and date.

FILTERING EXAMPLES:
• max_results=10 (limit to 10 emails)
• unread_only=True (only unread)
• search='project update' (keyword search)
• filter='receivedDateTime ge 2025-11-15' (date filter)

Without filters, may return 500+ emails causing slow performance and truncated results!

folder.description: Folder to list from (default: inbox). Use folder ID or well-known names: inbox, sentitems, drafts, deleteditems, junkemail

max_results.description: ⚠️ CRITICAL: Maximum number of messages to return (default: 50, max: 500). ALWAYS set this to prevent returning hundreds of emails! Recommended: 10-25 for quick scans, 50 for thorough reviews.

search.description: Search query string (searches subject, body, sender)

Get complete details of a specific email including full body content, attachments, and metadata.

tools.name: microsoft_outlook_search_messages
tools.description:
⚠️ MUST USE: execute_tool(tool_name='microsoft_outlook_search_messages', ...) - DO NOT call directly!

🎯 BEST FOR: Date range searches and multi-criteria filtering!

Advanced search across all email folders with multiple criteria. Supports date ranges, sender filters, attachment checks, and keyword search.

RECOMMENDED USAGE:
• ALWAYS use date_from/date_to for time-based queries ('last week', 'this month')
• Set max_results to reasonable limit (default: 50)
• Combine filters for precision (date + sender + keywords)

EXAMPLE: query='invoice', date_from='2025-11-01', date_to='2025-11-19', max_results=20

query.description: Search query (searches subject, body, sender, recipients)

max_results.description: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Maximum results to return (default: 50). Use lower values (10-25) for focused searches. Higher values (50-100) only when user needs comprehensive results.
